facts.statement: The study was a prospective cross-sectional analysis of 116 eyes from 58 people with Behçet's disease and 60 eyes from 30 healthy controls who were matched by age and sex.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: Researchers used optical coherence tomography angiography to measure the density and flow area of blood vessels in the superficial and deep capillary layers of the retina.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: Both groups of people with Behçet's disease had significantly lower vascular density and flow area in the superficial and deep retinal capillary layers compared to the healthy control group.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The flow area of the optic nerve head was significantly smaller in the group with a history of eye involvement than in both the group without eye involvement and the healthy control group.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The flow area of the radial peripapillary capillaries was significantly lower in both groups of people with Behçet's disease than in the healthy control group.
facts.subject: humans
